knowledge_gaps: The proposed prefix permutation already exists in the current workflow. The report should identify its incremental contribution and justify originality 5/10; potential 8/10 remains speculative without diagnostic-to-validation evidence.
Substitution versus deletion does not isolate positional effects: replacement introduces new content, while deletion changes length and positions. Explicit positional controls remain missing.

Reproduction requires exact frequency-bin boundaries, edit-count rounding, replacement sampling rules, timestamp eligibility, and handling of partially matched draws. Comparisons need the same eligible users and source positions to avoid selection bias.
The pseudocode does not specify exception-safe restoration: a buffer-verification error must not prevent restoration of model modes, buffers, and RNG states.

The report lacks a bounded experiment connecting diagnostic changes to pinned macro validation HR@10. Code difficulty 4/10 may underestimate matching, state preservation, and full-catalog recommendation integration.
